# Andesine

> Andesine is an open-source workspace for docs, knowledge, and structured content. Teams write in a real-time editor with properties, schemas, and custom elements. AI agents read and edit content through the API and MCP server. Content publishes to hosted docs sites, GitHub, or any app. Use the cloud app or self-host it.

## Product

- [Home](https://andesine.app/index.md): Use cases, workspace, publishing, open source, and pricing.
- [Pricing](https://andesine.app/pricing/index.md): Plans, limits, and a plan comparison.
- [Editor](https://andesine.app/product/editor/index.md): Real-time editing, blocks, Markdown shortcuts, offline work, and versions.
- [Content model](https://andesine.app/product/content-model/index.md): Collections, properties, content areas, schemas, and generated types.
- [Andesine Pages](https://andesine.app/pages/index.md): Docs sites, hosted or built from the open-source template.
- [AI and agents](https://andesine.app/product/ai-agents/index.md): AI answers with sources, and AI apps connected through MCP.
- [API & CLI](https://andesine.app/product/developers/index.md): The API, TypeScript SDK, CLI, webhooks, and API keys.
- [Extensions](https://andesine.app/product/extensions/index.md): Andesine Pages, GitHub Sync, and building your own extensions.

## Use cases

- [Product docs](https://andesine.app/use-cases/documentation/index.md): Write docs together, then publish a site, sync with GitHub, or use the API.
- [Headless CMS](https://andesine.app/use-cases/headless-cms/index.md): Blogs, changelogs, and in-app content, delivered through the API.
- [Team knowledge base](https://andesine.app/use-cases/knowledge-base/index.md): Search, AI answers, and access control for team knowledge.
- [Centralized hub](https://andesine.app/use-cases/central-hub/index.md): One source of facts and guides for people, apps, and agents.
- [Documentation](https://andesine.app/docs): Setup, editor, collections, publishing, API, MCP, and self-hosting.
- [Documentation for LLMs](https://andesine.app/docs/llms.txt): Index of the docs as Markdown pages.

## Open source

- [Source code](https://github.com/vriteio/andesine): The repository.
- [Self-hosting](https://andesine.app/docs/self-hosting/): Run Andesine on your own servers.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/vriteio/andesine/releases): Release notes.
